Viltepso (viltolarsen) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-530192  
Guideline Name 
Viltepso (viltolarsen)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
3/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Viltepso  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting both of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD)  


=== PDF PAGE 1942 ===
Page 1942 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Presence of a mutation of the dystrophin gene amenable to exon 53 skipping  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 4 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist with expertise in the treatment of DMD  
 
AND 
 
4 - Dose will not exceed 80 milligrams per kilogram of body weight infused once weekly  
 
AND 
 
5 - Submission of medical records including results of baseline North Star Ambulatory 
Assessment (NSAA) confirming the patient is ambulatory without needing an assistive device 
(e.g., without side-by-side assist, cane, walker, wheelchair, etc.) as evidenced by NSAA 
scoring  
 
AND 
 
6 - Patient will not receive Viltepso in combination with Duvyzat (givinostat) or other exon-
skipping therapies for DMD [e.g., Amondys 45 (casimersen), Exondys 51 (eteplirsen), 
Vyondys 53 (golodirsen)]  
 
Product Name:Viltepso  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


=== PDF PAGE 1943 ===
Page 1943 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is tolerating therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Dose will not exceed 80 milligrams per kilogram of body weight infused once weekly  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist with expertise in the treatment of DMD  
 
AND 
 
4 - Submission of medical records including results of recent North Star Ambulatory 
Assessment (NSAA) confirming patient is maintaining ambulatory status without needing an 
assistive device (e.g., without side-by-side assist, cane, walker, wheelchair, etc.) as 
evidenced by NSAA scoring  
 
AND 
 
5 - Patient will not receive Viltepso in combination with Duvyzat (givinostat) or other exon-
skipping therapies for DMD [e.g., Amondys 45 (casimersen), Exondys 51 (eteplirsen), 
Vyondys 53 (golodirsen)]  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
2/26/2026  
Added submission of NSAA testing for confirmation of ambulatory sta
tus.
